articles.summary: Dividend will be paid April 15, 2026 to holders of record March 31 as OFG steps up 2026 capital actions with a 17% increase to $0.35 per share.
articles.title: OFG Bancorp Increases Regular Quarterly Common Stock Cash Dividend to $0.35

articles.summary: Board approval adds an open-ended $200M buyback to OFG’s existing plan, which still had $38.1M available as of Dec. 31, 2025, expanding capital actions.
articles.title: OFG Bancorp Announces New $200 Million Share Repurchase Plan

articles.summary: EPS climbed to $1.27 in Q4 and $4.58 for 2025, while OFG Bancorp lifted core revenues, bought back $91.6M of shares and booked record $2.57B in loans.
articles.title: OFG Bancorp Reports 4Q25 & 2025 Results
